title: SVG rasterised to premultiplied RGBA uploaded unconverted into the BGRA (straight-alpha) sprite atlas
expected_finding: Image::to_image_data calls render_single_frame(.., to_brga = false), so the tiny-skia pixmap (premultiplied RGBA byte order) is copied into the B8G8R8A8_UNORM atlas that every other path fills with straight-alpha BGRA; the sprite shader reads R and B swapped (#38BDF8 shows as #F8BD38) and the colour still premultiplied
